about: Spots where the server blocks every move although the L2J geodata shows open ground (a bot got stuck and our route walk gave up). Active points (manual, or 2 separate episodes) are walls for docs/plan/tools/geopath.js (every route unless the start / goal lies inside), keep field_areas.js entry routes out, and swarm.js huntTarget never picks a monster inside. Learned by swarm.js geoBlockLearn (GEOLEARN-PURE). Set "disabled": true to switch one off.

points.why: Tank3 (leader) stuck twice on 2026-10-09: 15:00-15:04 at -53976,146072 and 16:28-16:36 at -54024,145992 / -54056,146120 / -54136,146200 / -54120,146248 (z -2880); geodata route existed, every move blocked, side-steps + 3 new routes failed (coordinator 16:36)
